items.title: LangSmith Tool Gateway: Secure, governed tool use for agents
items.en_title: LangSmith Tool Gateway: Secure, governed tool use for agents
items.en_oneliner: Now in public beta, LangSmith's Tool Gateway centralizes credential, identity, and access handling for agent tool calls, adding policy controls, approval flows, and trace visibility.

items.title: Devin for Databricks Migrations: Less time migrating, more time building
items.en_title: Devin for Databricks Migrations: Less time migrating, more time building
items.en_oneliner: A new Devin–Databricks collaboration speeds enterprise migrations away from legacy data platforms, so engineers can focus their time on building with data.

items.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.en_title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI explains its internal performance system: Codex-powered workflows that continuously surface and fix performance issues so ChatGPT stays responsive as it scales.

items.title: v2.71.0 (2026-11-18)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.71.0 is out, with changes to how multi-agent peer networks connect and how their interfaces are named, plus support for a new model provider, Stav.

In Claude Code 2.1.328, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 gain an automatic mode across Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry, and the apps gateway, and interactive sessions that skip permission prompts now begin there.

items.title: Deploying Daybreak Red
items.en_title: Deploying Daybreak Red
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI presents the Daybreak Red reference architecture, explaining how to build a supervised security investigation workflow with safety controls and monitoring in place.

items.title: Explore the Codex Security Plugin
items.en_title: Explore the Codex Security Plugin
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI demos the full Codex Security Plugin workflow, from setup to reviewing scan results.

items.title: See PR scans in action
items.en_title: See PR scans in action
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI shows how PR scans fit into the pull request workflow and present their findings.

items.title: Get started with Daybreak Blue
items.en_title: Get started with Daybreak Blue
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI walks through signing up for Daybreak Blue and configuring it so new users can start quickly.

items.title: Checking for NGINX2Root and Java4Shell with Threats in Devin Security
items.en_title: Checking for NGINX2Root and Java4Shell with Threats in Devin Security
items.en_oneliner: Devin Security's Threats feature now checks customer code for the newly disclosed NGINX2Root and Java4Shell flaws and helps patch them.

items.title: Connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more to Copilot
items.en_title: Connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more to Copilot
items.en_oneliner: Copilot adds eight GitHub-verified MCP connectors, bringing Box, Supabase, Calendly and more into public preview.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon is now available in Devin
items.en_title: Gemini 4 Neon is now available in Devin
items.en_oneliner: Devin's desktop and command-line apps now support Gemini 4 Neon, which posts a 46.2% score on the FrontierCode 2.0 benchmark — the strongest showing yet from a Google model, at roughly a third of Claude Opus 5.5's cost.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
items.en_title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot now offers Google's latest Gemini 4 Neon for agentic coding, multistep tool calls and knowledge tasks.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
items.en_title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
items.en_oneliner: The newest member of the Gemini 4 family, built for fast end-to-end completion of complex coding, knowledge work, and science tasks — positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen to balance frontier capability with cost efficiency, now available in the Gemini API and AI Studio.

items.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
items.en_title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
items.en_oneliner: RadixArk's 27B-parameter DaisyRose explores getting stronger model performance from less post-training effort.

items.title: Announcing Data Annotation Queues
items.en_title: Announcing Data Annotation Queues
items.en_oneliner: Use LangSmith’s Data Annotation Queues to review logs, label data, and build datasets that take LLM apps from prototype to production.

items.title: Catch production failures early with LangSmith Alerts
items.en_title: Catch production failures early with LangSmith Alerts
items.en_oneliner: Set up real-time alerts on error rates, latency, and feedback scores to catch production issues before users notice.

items.title: Your coding agent bill doubled. Here’s how to fix it.
items.en_title: Your coding agent bill doubled. Here’s how to fix it.
items.en_oneliner: Bills spiral when usage stays invisible — bring Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other tools’ spend into one view to trace, compare, and control it.

items.title: v0.24.0
items.en_oneliner: The Agents SDK ships version 0.24.0, unifying run-wide function error formatting and adding MCP discovery annotations, while improving recovery, sandbox safety, and tracing.

items.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
items.en_title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
items.en_oneliner: A hands-on analysis from Hugging Face explains why fine-tuning often runs longer than FLOPs estimates suggest, and how to predict its time more reliably.

items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.en_title: Genie 4 is now available
items.en_oneliner: DeepMind's interactive world model Genie 4 is now open, turning text or image prompts into explorable worlds you can move through in real time.

items.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
items.en_title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
items.en_oneliner: The Gemini app has lowered the memory bar for Android devices, so phones with less memory can now use Gemini Live and custom image creation.

items.title: Customize GitHub Copilot for your team
items.en_title: Customize GitHub Copilot for your team
items.en_oneliner: Team customizations are now generally available for organization teams, letting members share the Copilot plugins the team relies on without repeating the same setup individually.
